lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters forming a semi-regular grid pattern on the lateral flank posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting with the circular blobs to form a lattice-like structure on the posterior flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A horizontal linear feature on the mid-lateral flank characterized by a sharp vertical gradient from light (superior) to shadow (inferior).

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple commensal fish silhouettes visible in the ventral water column below the pectoral fin and main fuselage.
